QUOTE: "By default that renames the member to `private_foo`, so `ctx->foo` no longer compiles from application code." and "#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the macro definition and states that by default the member is renamed to private_foo, and that with the opt-out defined, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to plain `x`.
